answer: Treat identities like trees in an orchard: each must be planted with a bond and tended every epoch. An agent locks 50 POA for 100 epochs and answers a fresh seeded prompt each round; skip six and the bond decays. A sybil farm of 1,000 keys must lock 50,000 POA and pay for 1,000 answers per epoch, while kin-linked keys that wander into grading each other are excluded, so the farm sits on a lonely mesa earning nothing it did not pay for.
